subject.title: fix(memory): recover from same-file legacy index divergence

question: Should the same canonical-wins recovery contract used for legacy sidecar imports also permanently govern divergent legacy tables inside the canonical per-agent Memory Core database?
rationale: This is a durable persisted-state policy: accepting the patch resolves Gateway startup but intentionally chooses canonical data and removes the legacy representation after validation.

options.title: Approve canonical-wins recovery
options.body: Confirm that canonical rows are authoritative for same-file conflicts, then require a rebase and fresh upgrade proof against the actual merge result.

options.title: Retain legacy data for a different recovery flow
options.body: Keep same-file divergences recoverable without dropping legacy tables until a different operator-visible migration policy is designed.

recommendation.title: Approve canonical-wins recovery
recommendation.body: Confirm that canonical rows are authoritative for same-file conflicts, then require a rebase and fresh upgrade proof against the actual merge result.

likelyOwner.reason: The merged sibling recovery establishes the closest existing migration contract for this decision.
